title: Lunch with von Däniken attended by Joe Rogan
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lunch with von Däniken attended by Joe Rogan, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I once organized a lunch with von Däniken that Joe Rogan attended.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says he once organized a lunch with Erich von Däniken, a writer known for saying that beings from elsewhere visited ancient people. He says Joe Rogan, a famous podcast host, came to that lunch.
